summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on data quality, specifically regarding the aggregation of metrics (like 'футфоли'/'footfall') for networks. [p1] initially questioned how network footfall was calculated, especially since historical aggregation to July was not previously done.

[me] confirmed that some minor adjustments were made for networks in the production environment starting June 13th and that data for `aka_test` had been adjusted and re-aggregated. [p1] stated that while they questioned it, it wasn't a major problem.

Later, [p1] requested confirmation on whether all data could be copied from January 1, 2024, to July 1, 2024.
decisions: Data can be copied for the period of January 1, 2024, to July 1, 2024.
